payload.expected_edge: The prospectively defined inventory-reversal mechanism may converge to VWAP; contaminated exercise cannot establish whether it has an edge.
expected_failure_modes: fundamental information makes the overnight repricing persistent
the developing VWAP follows price rather than serving as a useful consensus reference
the fixed 09:45 observation misses later inventory normalization
modeled costs and adverse selection exceed any gross effect
payload.expected_holding_period: 09:45 entry for minutes to 120 complete bars
payload.expected_market_regime: non-news overnight dislocation with two-sided liquidity
invalidation_conditions: gap-down magnitude is less than 0.50 percent
09:44 close does not exceed 09:43 high or is not below VWAP
signal window, prior close, VWAP, or 09:45 entry is unavailable
known_risks: overnight repricing reflects persistent information rather than inventory
developing VWAP follows rather than anchors the move
modeled costs exceed any gross effect
payload.market_assumption: One-sided overnight inventory in liquid index ETFs can normalize after the open when the gap-down stops extending and price turns toward VWAP.
payload.mechanism: One long entry at 09:45 follows a negative 0.50 percent or larger gap and an adjacent upside reversal below developing session VWAP.
required_evidence: previous bound regular-session final minute close
exact 09:45 entry bar open and complete frozen lifecycle
required_indicators: previous regular-session close and current regular-session open
first-fifteen-minute low and adjacent reversal bar
payload.title: Gap-down overnight inventory reversal toward VWAP in liquid ETFs
